description: This file defines the SAML2AuthenticateUser class, which extends SugarAuthenticateUser to handle user authentication via SAML2 in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for authenticating users and loading user sessions, referencing external user data and session variables.

classes.name: SAML2AuthenticateUser
classes.description: A class extending SugarAuthenticateUser to implement SAML2-based user authentication.

methods.name: authenticateUser
methods.description: Performs user authentication based on session and user data, returning user ID if successful.

methods.name: loadUserOnLogin
methods.description: Handles user login process, authenticates user, and loads user session.
